regions.Vice City: The neon heart of Leonida — story missions, crime and money.
regions.Leonida Keys: The island chain south of the city — stranger strands.
regions.Port Gellhorn: The faded resort coast — activities, races and long counts.
regions.Ambrosia: The inland sugar town — world trophies and strange sights.
regions.Mount Kalaga: The wild north — the state's highest ground.
regions.Ocean Beach: The beachfront — collectibles found out in the open.

own.name: Our own advice, worked out from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own. Work the roadmap in order — story, strangers, activities, collectibles, crime, then cleanup — and keep this page open as your checklist. It is the last trophy you will earn.
trophies.missable_note: Unlocks itself when the other 54 are earned.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
steps: Clean up crime, money and world trophies

trophies.guide: Finish Gone Fishing, the opening mission. It pops as the story starts: follow the on-screen objectives through the intro and the trophy is yours before you reach free roam.
trophies.hint: Nothing to prepare: start the story and this pops during the intro, before free roam opens up.
trophies.missable_note: Opening mission — cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
steps: Follow Gone Fishing to its end

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. Play the main missions in order until the chapter closes; the roadmap page shows where this sits in the story run.
trophies.hint: Chapter 1 closes on its own when the last mission ends - no side content is needed for this one.
trophies.missable_note: Story chapter — finish the chapter's missions.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
steps: Play the Chapter 1 missions in order

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Keep playing the main missions; the chapter trophy pops when the last mission of the chapter ends.
trophies.missable_note: Story chapter — finish the chapter's missions.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
steps: Play the Chapter 2 missions in order

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. The story carries you through Vice City itself here — follow the missions to the chapter's close.
trophies.missable_note: Story chapter — finish the chapter's missions.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
steps: Play the Chapter 3 missions in order

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. The last chapter before the finale: play its missions through and the trophy pops at the chapter's end.
trophies.missable_note: Story chapter — finish the chapter's missions.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
steps: Play the Chapter 4 missions in order

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. It is the story's last job: finish it and the gold pops. Do the missable partner trophies before this point, while the story still pairs you up.
trophies.missable_note: Final mission — finish the story.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
steps: Do Hot Together and Retail Therapy before the finale

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. Follow the mission to its end; if a section fails, retry it from the checkpoint and keep going.
trophies.missable_note: Story mission — finish it; a failed run costs nothing but a retry.
trophies.name: Trust
steps: Start Breakfast Run from the story

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. It is a heist, so expect a setup and a payoff: finish both halves and the trophy pops.
trophies.missable_note: Story mission — finish it; a failed run costs nothing but a retry.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
steps: Start The Cartel Heist from the story

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Follow it through to the end; the trophy pops when the mission closes.
trophies.missable_note: Story mission — finish it; a failed run costs nothing but a retry.
trophies.name: Family Matters
steps: Start Child's Play from the story

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Play it through; the trophy pops when the mission closes.
trophies.missable_note: Story mission — finish it; a failed run costs nothing but a retry.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. It takes place at the airport — expect a loud one. Finish the takedown and the trophy pops.
trophies.missable_note: Story mission — finish it; a failed run costs nothing but a retry.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
steps: Start VCIA Takedown from the story

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Play it through to the end; the trophy pops when the operation closes.
trophies.missable_note: Story mission — finish it; a failed run costs nothing but a retry.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
steps: Start Operation Savage Glory from the story

trophies.guide: Attain 100% completion: every mission, stranger strand, activity, collectible and challenge the game counts. Use the Roadmap and the Next-up planner to find what is left; this gold is the last step before the platinum.
trophies.missable_note: Earned last, from everything else — nothing to miss.
trophies.name: A Long Road
steps: Check the Next-up planner for what remains

trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts. Stunts are the jumps, near-misses and air time the game scores as you drive: chain them on long highway runs and the count climbs fast. Use the counter on this trophy to track your 250.
trophies.missable_note: Counted across the whole game — anytime.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
steps: Drive fast on highways and ramps
Log each stunt on the counter until 250

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: races, the shooting range, fishing, the arcade, and the rest. One try each is enough — you do not need to win, just to take part.
trophies.missable_note: One try each is enough — anytime.
trophies.name: Master of None
steps: Open the activities list in the game
Tick each off on the counter

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Learn each range's target pattern on a slow first run, then chase gold once you know the layout. The counter tracks how many of the 42 you have golded.
trophies.missable_note: Replayable — gold each challenge in your own time.
trophies.name: The Shootist
steps: Gold all 42 — tick them off as you go

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every location. Each location runs its own race, so win one at each and the trophy pops. The official description does not pin down how many locations there are, so this guide does not guess a number — win them all and it pops.
trophies.missable_note: Every location is its own race — anytime.
trophies.name: Top Fun
steps: Find each Top Fun drone race
Win one race at every location

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — different events, not the same race twenty times. Work through the race list, win each one once, and tick it off; the counter keeps your 20.
trophies.missable_note: Different events, not the same race 20 times.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
steps: Tick each win off on the counter

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fish the challenge, watch Cal's catch, and beat his total before the timer ends. Lose and you can challenge him again.
trophies.missable_note: Retryable — challenge Cal again if you lose.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
steps: Out-fish Cal before time runs out

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game: any machine, any game, played start to finish. Walk up to a cabinet, put your time in, and see the game through to its end.
trophies.missable_note: Any machine, any game — anytime.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
steps: Play one game through to the end

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Work through Andy's stranger strand mission by mission until his last one appears, then finish it.
trophies.missable_note: Stranger strand — finish Andy's chain.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
steps: Find Andy and start his strand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Work through Kenton's stranger strand until his last mission appears, then finish it — the name says a boat is involved, so expect water.
trophies.missable_note: Stranger strand — finish Kenton's chain.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
steps: Find Kenton and start his strand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Work through Billy's stranger strand until his last mission appears, then finish it.
trophies.missable_note: Stranger strand — finish Billy's chain.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
steps: Find Billy and start his strand

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Each strand is a chain of missions for one stranger — finish any 8 strands, not necessarily every one in the game. The counter tracks your eight.
trophies.missable_note: Any 8 strands — you do not need all of them.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
steps: Finish a strand end to end

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Work through Randy's stranger strand until his last mission appears, then finish it.
trophies.missable_note: Stranger strand — finish Randy's chain.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
steps: Find Randy and start his strand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Work through Tyrone's stranger strand until his last mission appears, then finish it.
trophies.missable_note: Stranger strand — finish Tyrone's chain.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
steps: Find Tyrone and start his strand

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. The spots are the quiet viewpoints the game marks — sit, meditate, move to the next. The official description does not pin down how many spots there are, so the counter here is yours to fill in as you find them.
trophies.missable_note: Spots stay open — anytime.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's strand points you at one rare animal — track it, take the shot cleanly, and bring it back to him.
trophies.missable_note: Bret's strand points you at the animal.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards hide across Leonida; a set is complete when you hold every card in it. Three full sets pops the trophy — the counter tracks your three.
trophies.missable_note: Cards stay where they are — anytime.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK It is the in-world check-in — open it at landmarks, shops and viewpoints until 100 spots are logged. The counter keeps your 100.
trophies.missable_note: Counted across the whole game — anytime.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
steps: Open WAiNK It at a landmark

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges are the game's side objectives — stunts, races, collectibles and more all feed this count, so it climbs as you play everything else.
trophies.missable_note: Challenges feed in from everything — anytime.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
steps: Log completions on the counter until 50

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner, lose a 4-star wanted level and escape. Get to 4 stars together, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the heat dies. Do this while the story still has you working as a pair — after the finale your partner may not be around to help.
trophies.hint: Do this before the finale — once the story moves on, your partner may not be beside you for the getaway.
trophies.missable_note: MISSABLE — needs your partner beside you. Do it while the story still pairs you up, before the finale.
trophies.name: Hot Together
steps: Play with your partner beside you
Break line of sight and stay hidden until the heat dies

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Hit three shops in one run, keep the heat on between robberies, and do not get caught. Like Hot Together, this needs your partner — do it before the finale.
trophies.missable_note: MISSABLE — partner-dependent. Do it while the story still pairs you up, before the finale.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
steps: Play with your partner beside you
Rob a shop, keep the wanted level

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Every new model you drive counts — variety beats repeats, so drive something different each time. The counter tracks your 100 discoveries.
trophies.missable_note: Variety beats repeats — anytime.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
steps: Drive a vehicle you have never driven

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Group enemies first, trigger Combat Focus, and chain five takedowns before it ends. A crowded street or a gang hideout is the place to try it.
trophies.missable_note: Retryable — set it up again if you fall short.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — leave the airport your own way, not through the front door. The description keeps the exact route vague on purpose; try the runways and service roads and leave without a ticket.
trophies.missable_note: Retryable — try another route if the first fails.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos — take a Rhino tank for a drive. Tanks live where the military keeps them; find one, climb in, and roll it out onto the street.
trophies.missable_note: Find a Rhino and drive it — anytime.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet — no alarms, no witnesses calling it in. If you are spotted, leave and try again; a clean run is the whole trophy.
trophies.missable_note: If you are spotted, leave and try again.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
steps: Leave with the goods, no alarm

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Five separate vault jobs, each ending in a clean getaway — the counter tracks your five.
trophies.missable_note: Five separate jobs — anytime.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Hit a truck on the road, take the cash, and lose the heat — the classic blitz, done right.
trophies.missable_note: Trucks run all day — anytime.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
steps: Find an armored truck on the road
Stop it and take the cash

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Every district, beach, swamp and town — the map fills in as you go. Drive the highways, walk the back roads, and the trophy pops when the last corner is uncovered.
trophies.missable_note: The map fills in as you go — anytime.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
steps: Cover the map until nothing is blank

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang. Every gang has its own operation — hit one per gang and the trophy pops when the last gang's operation is robbed.
trophies.missable_note: One operation per gang — anytime.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Find a bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and take in the view. The easiest trophy on the list — do it whenever you pass the beach.
trophies.missable_note: A quiet moment — anytime.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
steps: Order a cocktail with a view

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car through the showroom glass — the classic way out, and the trophy pops as the glass breaks.
trophies.missable_note: Pick a showroom and drive out through the glass — anytime.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
steps: Enter a vehicle showroom in a car

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Bowl a full game at the alley and finish it — follow-through is the whole point.
trophies.missable_note: Bowl a full game — anytime.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
steps: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. The description does not pin down which partnership moment this is, so this guide does not guess one — it is flagged as possibly missable, and the safe play is to keep a manual save before the big partnership choices in the story.
trophies.missable_note: POSSIBLY MISSABLE — reads like a story partnership moment. Keep a save before big partnership choices.
trophies.name: Personal Best
steps: Keep a manual save before partnership choices

trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse. This is a story-choice trophy: a decision you make shapes it. Keep a manual save before the major choices so you can see the other outcome if you need to.
trophies.missable_note: MISSABLE — a story choice. Keep a manual save before major choices so you can see the other outcome.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
steps: Keep a manual save before major story choices
Make the choice and play it through

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. Something you only get on a second attempt — if a moment goes wrong the first time, try it again instead of reloading an old save. That is the whole trick of this one.
trophies.missable_note: POSSIBLY MISSABLE — reads like a second-attempt moment. If a moment goes wrong the first time, try it again instead of reloading.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? A strange one-off event somewhere in Leonida. This guide does not invent a location the official description never names — it is flagged as possibly missable, so when something strange happens in the world, stop and see it through.
trophies.missable_note: POSSIBLY MISSABLE — reads like a one-off strange event. See it when it appears; it may not come back.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
steps: Explore Leonida and watch for strange events
See one through to the end

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. While bowling, take someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle — timing and a steady hand, and you can try again as often as you like.
trophies.missable_note: Retryable — bowl again if you miss.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
steps: Be at the bowling alley in a vehicle

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from jobs; launder them through your contacts until $250,000 is clean. The counter tracks your clean total.
trophies.missable_note: Launder as you earn — anytime.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Shops, clothes, cars, food — it all counts toward the total. Buy what you need as you play and the trophy comes on its own.
trophies.missable_note: Shops, clothes, cars, food — it all counts.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
steps: Buy gear, clothes and cars as you play

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Buy every garage on the market and the trophy is yours — garages are also where your collection lives, so this pairs with Whip It Good.
trophies.missable_note: Buy every garage on the market — anytime.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Photograph or register ten different vehicles through the app — the counter tracks your ten.
trophies.missable_note: Ten different vehicles — anytime.
trophies.name: On the Spot
